summary: Anthony Vasi, 47, of Newport Beach, California, died when a commercial rafting trip's raft became stuck on rocks in the "Birth Canal" feature of Triplet Falls on the Green River in Dinosaur National Monument around 12:15 p.m. Saturday; Vasi was ejected and trapped, became unresponsive while a rescue swimmer moved him into the main current, and CPR on a downstream gravel bar failed; Classic Air Medical arrived at 1:30 p.m., declared him deceased, and flew the body to Vernal, Utah.
location: Triplet Falls, Green River, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: Dinosaur National Monument staff; Classic Air Medical; Colorado Parks & Wildlife; Moffat County Sheriff's Office
notes: Family/friends commercial trip led by outfitter Adrift Adventures (Jensen, UT); Green River ~2,350 cfs, remote canyon, no cell service; monument rangers rafted to the scene to investigate and assisted the group to Echo Park; Moffat County Coroner ruled the death a drowning (NPS July-9 release (page opened run 497)); first indexed Moffat County 2019 row. Gephardt Daily article (opened run 597) corroborates the NPS rafting-fatality details: Triplet Falls flip, ~10 min underwater, ~90 min CPR, Classic Air Medical declared him deceased and flew him to Vernal.
